title: Write Alt Text for Complex Images
description: Given a chart and an infographic, write appropriate alt text and long descriptions.
problemStatement:
## Write Accessible Descriptions

**Image 1:** A line chart titled "Website Traffic 2025". X‑axis: months Jan–Jun. Y‑axis: visits. Data: Jan=1000, Feb=1500, Mar=1200, Apr=1800, May=2200, Jun=2800.

**Image 2:** An infographic with three sections: "Reduce, Reuse, Recycle". Each section has an illustration and bullet points: Reduce (buy less packaging, bring your own bag), Reuse (use refillable bottles, repair clothes), Recycle (separate paper/plastic, compost food waste).

For each image:
1. Write a concise `alt` text (under 150 chars).
2. Write a long description that a screen reader user could read to understand all information.
3. Show how you would code the image with `alt` and `aria-describedby` (for Image 1) or an HTML alternative (for Image 2).
hints: Alt text for the chart should convey the trend and key values.
Long description for the chart can be a data table.
For the infographic, consider creating an equivalent HTML structure with lists.
expectedOutput: Two code blocks: one for the chart with alt, aria-describedby, and long description; one for the infographic as semantic HTML.
